name: Upcoming Adaptations Sources
instructions: Cross-reference at least 3 sources per title. Prefer Deadline and Hollywood Reporter for confirmed dates. Use Publishers Weekly and Goodreads for titles not yet covered by entertainment press.

sources.name: Deadline
sources.focus: Confirmed theatrical release dates, studio deals, production news

sources.name: Hollywood Reporter
sources.focus: Curated list with casting, directors, and streamer acquisitions

sources.name: Rotten Tomatoes
sources.focus: Critic and audience anticipation, hype levels, most-watched trailers

sources.name: BookBub
sources.focus: Reader-community perspective, mid-tier and romance titles often missed elsewhere

sources.name: Collider
sources.focus: Genre fiction, sci-fi, fantasy, horror adaptations with detailed production coverage

sources.name: Entertainment Weekly
sources.focus: Casting announcements, first looks, streaming debut dates

sources.name: Vulture
sources.focus: Prestige TV adaptations, literary fiction, New York Magazine cultural commentary

sources.name: Publishers Weekly
sources.focus: Trade publication — catches adaptation deals before entertainment press, option announcements

sources.name: Screen Rant
sources.focus: Comprehensive coverage including international productions and smaller streamers

sources.name: Wikipedia 2026 Films
sources.focus: Most complete and well-maintained list of confirmed releases with dates — use as completeness check
